column1: # check_src_main_max_rss_kb: max RSS (kB) of `check src/main.yo` (memory_ratchet.sh).

#   2026-10-20 (v0.2.67 cycle): 973268 -> 1099472 (+13.0% since 2026-09-30, #1041). Most of it predates the cycle: develop measured 1058384 at 6ccddf25d (run 39352732563) and 1061416 at e40dc17ac (#1485, run 39368390820), 91% of the +10% tolerance. The cycle's correctness fixes then stopped sharing instantiations that had been wrongly shared: enum identity keyed per declaration (#1501), one capture struct per instantiation (#1503) and per producer future (#1506), CTFE memo entries per enum type argument (#1507), one specialization per distinct borrowing-operand producer (#1508), compiled match arms kept under check (#1493, +0.5%). Measured: 1083500 at 400413ac3 (run 39377121103; the first red ratchet, unseen because the next merge superseded that battery) and 1099472 at dae821c2f (run 39403652463; +3.6% over e40dc17ac). The baseline is the merged head's value. Per-PR attribution was not done (no Linux box this cycle); reclaim it with the post-v0.2.67 sharing work (plans/handover/VBD_HANDOVER_2026-10-20.md §0.2).

#   2026-10-30 (fix(develop) after #1673, decision 48 W6a: --cycle-collector off is the default, and the compiler builds itself without the collector): 4091380 -> 3608080 (-11.8%; the floor was 3682242). Measured by the develop battery at 92efeee86 (run 40992831109). The battery at 59573a695 (run 40938853133, collector on) measured 4222352, so the step is W6a's: the collector-free compiler carries no tracked-object header and registers nothing (W6a's own A/B: check src/main.yo RSS x0.925). That head also carried #1676's Box layout, which this same PR reverts. Box layout's share is at most the head's few percent of headroom, inside the +10% ceiling either way.

# check_src_main_alloc_calls: malloc+calloc+realloc+aligned_alloc calls of `check src/main.yo` (eval_work_ratchet.sh), counted by an LD_PRELOAD shim on a glibc-malloc rebuild of the stage-2 C. ±5% both ways, not ±10%: the count is exact, so the tolerance is pure policy, and the creep it guards against ran about 5% per release (check ./src 113 s -> 177 s, v0.2.50 -> v0.2.61).

#   2026-10-14 (#1359): recorded at develop 229772321. Three CI runs agreed to the call (2769331795; 225431200 of them realloc; 166.4 GB requested). perf instructions:u was the other candidate and is unavailable: ubuntu-latest has no PMU ("PMU not available due to virtualization").

#   2026-10-15: 2769331795 -> 2996136722 (+8.2%), measured by the develop battery at fc37c4e54 (run 38678330962; both counted runs agree). Deliberate: the cost of VBD V4 (#1369, TypeValue :: Rc(TypeValueNode)). The evaluator does the same work: type_key calls are unchanged (13.08M), and keys of types that do not embed the compiler's TypeValue are byte-identical. The program checked is the compiler, whose TypeValue gained an Rc layer, so keys that embed it grew 21% (avg 4,659 -> 5,653 B, +456 MB of key strings). The two type_key-memoized predicates nominal_declares_move_only and type_lacks_copy_for_flip rebuild them on every call (+274M allocations); V4's identity memos saved -116M in hierarchy/intern. Attribution: issues/fixed/2026-10-15-v4-typevalue-rc-raises-the-check-allocation-count-by-7-percent.md.

#   2026-10-16 (perf/type-key-memo-identity): 2996136722 -> 1799052684 (-40.0%). The two type_key-keyed memos (nominal_declares_move_only, type_lacks_copy_for_flip) and value_to_signature_string's type signature are fronted by identity caches keyed by the TypeValue handle, valid within one type-key epoch, so a hit builds no key string; types that mention a SomeT are not cached (their trait lists grow in place). Measured with CI's method on a Linux x86_64 box (stage-2 C emitted by the tree-built stage 1, recompiled with clang -O2 on glibc malloc, eval_work_ratchet.sh): develop 0684c9c40 counts 2997740895 there (CI's 2996136722 + 0.05%, so the local method reproduces CI's), this branch on it 1782841149 (-40.53%; two runs agreeing to the call; the M4 DYLD estimate was 1782545714), and the merged head on develop 6fc6e3a0a 1799052684 (#1378, #1379 and #1396 add 0.9%). The baseline is the merged head's count.

#   2026-10-23 (fix(develop) after #1551, VBD V2b B5): 1799052684 -> 1961432937 (+9.0%). Measured by the develop battery at 6dee22187 (run 39896320817). The heads before B5 counted 1798075143 (265faa941, run 39880520347) and 1798619832 (399d3cc06, run 39891814319), so the +162.8M allocation calls are B5's: every access to one of the 377 RefCell globals now runs a with/with_mut closure, whose capture environment is allocated per call. Expected to come back when B0's expression-scoped get()/get_mut() projections replace the closures (decision 43 step 2, v0.2.73). Accepted with the maintainer's OK (2026-10-23).

#   2026-10-24 (fix(develop) after #1566, VBD V2b B1): 1961432937 -> 2123516331 (+8.3% over the baseline; +6.7% over the previous head). Measured by the develop battery at f271ed005 (run 40015972081; both counted runs agree to the call). The head before, c45d099b4 (run 39969986108), counted 1990498329; between them only #1565 (codegen-only: the handler-installation check of a type-qualified method call) and #1566 landed, so the step is B1: the explicit-copy regeneration spells 632 copies in src/ as `.clone()`, and until the B8 flip a `.clone()` of a collection is a deep copy where the implicit copy shared the handle. B1's own A/B measured check src/main.yo at 1.02x time and 0.998x RSS. Expected to come back at the flip (B8), when those copies are the copies the values model makes anyway and the shares they replaced are gone. Accepted with the maintainer's OK (2026-10-23).

#   2026-10-27 (fix(develop) after #1635, the VBD B4 explicit-copy wave): 2123516331 -> 2556249745 (+20.4%). The develop batteries counted 2183766904 at a27cd5f01 (run 40247079350), 2221872594 at af67fdf59 (#1616), 2235426601 at fdab9d551 (#1624), 2333244736 at 68182bfdf (#1625, #1626, +4.4%), 2529586378 at 9c432b3c9 (#1627, #1629-#1631, +8.4%) and 2533389015 at c3526f3fe (run 40371682048, the first red count). The tip's count was not taken on CI (the RSS step failed first in run 40387441095), so it was measured locally from that run's own bootstrap-stage2 artifact with the job's exact method (clang -O2 -I scripts/bootstrap/libc_mimalloc, alloc_count.so, setarch -R): 2556249745 at 6ec7f5064 (#1635, +0.9%). Each .clone() the sweep spelled is an allocation the implicit-share path did not make. Accepted under the maintainer's VBD rule; expected to come back with the unique-buffer flips and decision 43 step 2's projections.

#   2026-10-30 (fix(develop) after #1663, VBD V2c, decision 17): 2699179013 -> 2928830929 (+8.5%). V2c itself added +786.9M: the develop battery at c39c574be (run 40814434612) counted 2741359376 and the one at b8f86ebe2 (run 40905885640) 3528223482 (+28.7%). The old compiler checking the new tree counts 3523567672, so 99% of the step is what the checker does with the new source, not the clones the repair tool put into the compiler. The cause was a defect: the prelude's Rc/Arc Clone.clone (___dup(self)) has no ExprInfo in the table its callers are summarized against, and the mutation summary's conservative answer for it is never memoized and poisons every caller's memo. `_MsP.analyze` ran 226,750 times instead of 35,134, 187,000 of them in the Pattern.clone / clone_patterns cycle. That fix (issues/fixed/2026-10-30-rc-clone-calls-defeat-the-mutation-summary-memo.md) removes -680.2M on the merged head. It answers a ___dup(<first parameter>) body from its shape, and type_lacks_copy_for_flip's some-type test reads the identity cache. The rest is two parts. (1) About +106.6M is V2c's own cost: 786.9M raw minus 680.2M fixed, from the ~2,100 Rc.clone(h) calls the checker now evaluates where it used to read a bare name. Each is a static method call on a generic type, about 12.3K allocation calls apiece at top level, measured in a micro. (2) About +77.8M is the develop heads #1664-#1677: unfixed, b8f86ebe2 counts 3531141633 and 0ce055183 counts 3608981606. With the fix applied, 4db9a0c8a counts 2864840044, 92efeee86 counts 2952217454 (+87.4M: #1675 allocator v2's larger std and #1676 Box layout) and 0ce055183 counts 2928830929 (-23.4M: #1677 reverts Box layout, so allocator v2's share is about +64M). All counts are local, by CI's method on the Linux box: the tree-built stage 1 emits the stage-2 C, recompiled by clang -O2 -I scripts/bootstrap/libc_mimalloc, with alloc_count.so and setarch -R. That method reproduces CI within +0.1% (c39c574be 2744300771 locally, b8f86ebe2 3531141633). B8 is not expected to reclaim part (1): it is the checking of explicit handle copies decision 17 keeps permanently, not deep copies the flip turns into moves (the clones inside the compiler binary cost only ~7.6M). A cheaper evaluator resolution of Rc.clone(h)/Arc.clone(h) calls would reclaim it. Accepted under the maintainer's VBD rule (raise the memory baselines whenever needed during VBD). Accepted with the maintainer's OK (2026-10-30).

#   2026-11-01 (#1702, perf(evaluator): the generic-impl method cache): 2928830929 -> 2449599225 (-16.4%). Measured on the merged head 6605776a4 by CI's method on the Linux box (the tree-built stage 1 emits the stage-2 C, recompiled by clang -O2 -I scripts/bootstrap/libc_mimalloc, with alloc_count.so and setarch -R, REPEAT=2): both runs agree to the call. The ratchet itself instructed the lowering (failed 'improved beyond the ratchet'). #1702 caches find_methods_from_generic_impls per (SomeT-resolved receiver type_key, method name, trait-impl epoch, registration owner) — the generic-impl registry scan was ~58% of Rc.new's evaluation cost after the B2 handle-ctors sweep. Its own A/B on one fixed input tree (develop 37e09d951 vs the branch, gcc-built binaries) measured 3,083,603,188 -> 2,684,196,378 malloc+realloc calls (-12.9%), -7.11% instructions:u and -12.8% requested bytes; the further step to 2,449,599,225 is the merged heads between the two measurements (#1697-#1701, B3's prelude ctor deletions among them) and the different build of the counted binary. Local RSS reading on the same clang stand-in binary: 1,430,924 kB, +12.1% over the recorded check_src_main_max_rss_kb, but #1702's A/B attributes only +4.3 MB (+0.32%) to the cache; that entry is deliberately left for CI's battery to judge rather than raised from a local box.
